correctness.rationale: A cycle is never shattered: all but one edge 1 (same side) and last edge 0 (different sides) is inconsistent. On a forest each Boolean assignment to equality edges produces exactly two complementary vertex colorings per connected component; if first uses c_i in the prescribed a-set, the other uses t_i-c_i. Feasibility is precisely [z^a] product_i (z^{c_i}+z^{t_i-c_i})>0. Every c_i between 0 and floor(t_i/2) arises from a tree edge labeling, so the criterion is necessary and sufficient and independent of tree shape. Balanced assignments yield sum floor(t_i/2) <=a and |S|=sum(t_i-1)<=2a; all-positive spanning-tree labels exclude a one-component support since 1<=a<n, yielding |S|<=n-2. Star on 2a edges with >=a isolates (n>=3a+1) is shattered by explicit center/leaf/isolates construction, establishing exact VCdim=2a in stable range. Small a=2 exception from size profile and direct witnesses. Independent finite exact 100490 support tests for 2<=n<=6 agreed; these do not prove infinite generality.
